games.name: EA SPORTS FC
games.howToPlay: Pick your clubs, set a match length, and compete head-to-head or co-op. Controllers are ready at the console.

games.name: CALL OF DUTY
games.howToPlay: Jump into multiplayer matches or campaign missions. Ask staff for the current game mode and party setup.

games.name: GRAN TURISMO
games.howToPlay: Choose a car and track, then race solo or split-screen. Perfect for quick competitive sessions.

games.name: NBA 2K
games.howToPlay: Select your teams and tip off. Play quick matches or full quarters with friends on the same console.

games.name: MORTAL KOMBAT
games.howToPlay: Choose a fighter and battle in versus mode. Best for short, intense head-to-head rounds.

games.name: SPIDER-MAN
games.howToPlay: Swing through the city, take on missions, and enjoy the story. Ideal for solo sessions.

games.name: TEKKEN
games.howToPlay: Pick a character and duel in versus mode. Great warm-up fights between courses.

games.name: NEED FOR SPEED
games.howToPlay: Jump into street races, customize your ride vibe, and chase the podium with friends.

games.name: FORTNITE
games.howToPlay: Drop in, build, and compete in squads or solos. Staff can help with party and account setup.

games.name: ROCKET LEAGUE
games.howToPlay: Soccer with cars — score goals in short matches. Perfect for mixed-skill groups.

games.name: GOD OF WAR
games.howToPlay: Follow Kratos through epic combat and story missions. Best as a focused solo session.

games.name: MINECRAFT
games.howToPlay: Build, explore, and survive together. Great for casual creative sessions with friends.
